svg.title: Terminal session: isak@coolhed
svg.desc: A terminal on a rack-mounted monitor, logged in as isak@coolhed, types commands and shows their output. Running whoami prints: isak, devops student, sweden. Running kubectl get projects -n icoolhed lists each project with its status: loopline, artspecifikationer, isak-sandbox and readme-bot running; formcraft public. Running cat ~/now.txt prints: building loopline, a file server for producers; learning linux, bash, k3s, ci/cd pipelines.

g.text: loopline, a file server for producers
